content.short: MathWallet is a multichain Web3 wallet supporting over 200 blockchains on mobile, extension and web.
content.description: MathWallet is one of the longest-running multichain wallets, supporting more than 200 public chains including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, TON and Polkadot across its mobile app, browser extension, web wallet and hardware wallet, with cross-chain bridges and a dApp store. Blockscout's World Chain app marketplace lists it.
content.meta: MathWallet is a multichain Web3 wallet for 200+ chains, listed in the World Chain app directory.
